title: Firefox cache folders
whyItMatters: The Firefox cache keeps copies of pages, images and scripts from every site visited. Clearing history does not remove it, so it shows browsing activity on its own.
source: XDG Base Directory spec (cache under $XDG_CACHE_HOME, default ~/.cache) and the Mozilla profile cache2 layout: https://specifications.freedesktop.org/basedir-spec/latest/
notes: One folder per profile with cache2 inside. The Firefox snap keeps its cache under ~/snap/firefox/common/.cache/mozilla/firefox.
